trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do. Use the roadmap in this app: story first, then strangers and partners, then collectibles, activities, and finally the money-and-property cleanup. If one trophy is holding you up, open its guide here and check the missable note before starting a new save.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Official list (name, description, grade): Exophase GTA VI trophy list and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list, which agree on all 55 entries. Roadmap order is this app's own advice built from those official descriptions.

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It is the game's first story beat, so simply play from the start and follow the on-screen objectives; the trophy unlocks as the mission ends. Treat it as a tutorial: learn the movement, driving and interaction prompts here, because later trophies assume you know them.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own, from the official description; no external walkthrough needed for a story mission.

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Chapter trophies are unmissable if you keep following story markers, but this is a good point to start a rotating manual save: later choice-based trophies are much cheaper to fix from a Chapter 1 save than from a fresh game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Save advice is this app's own general trophy-hunting practice.

trophies.guide: Complete all Chapter 2 story missions. The name is shown exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. While you play, start noting stranger encounters and collectible spots you pass — Chapter 2 opens up more of Leonida, and anything you tick off now is one less trip in the collectibles stage.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists (both publish the asterisks). Advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's story missions. By now the city side of Leonida should be familiar; keep your rotating save habit and clear any stranger strands that appeared during this chapter before moving on, because strand availability is the easiest thing to lose track of.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Before you push into the endgame, pause and sweep anything time-sensitive: unfinished stranger strands, partner trophies, and choice-based trophies are all safer to settle now than after the final mission reshuffles the world.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final story mission. This is one of only two gold trophies, and it marks the end of Stage 1 of the roadmap. Keep a save from just before the finale: if anything in the missables list is still open, that save is your cheapest way back.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Official description and gold grade: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies like this one unlock automatically when the mission ends, so the only way to miss it is to not play the story. If you are replaying for a choice, this mission is a handy early checkpoint.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission. Heist missions usually pay well, so bank the money rather than spending it immediately — the cleanup stage needs $100,000 of shop spending and 8 garage properties, and story payouts are the cleanest funding source.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Money advice is this app's own, tied to the official descriptions of Treat Yo Self and Little Boxes.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. No special conditions: reach the mission in the story, finish it, and the trophy is yours. If a choice appears during the mission, remember that choices feed the Actions Speak Louder counter.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. As with the other named missions, this is a story-completion trophy with no hidden conditions. Keep following the story markers and it will unlock on mission completion.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Note the related free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can, which also involves VCIA: finishing this mission first teaches you the location, which makes the free-roam version easier to plan.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Official descriptions: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. The VCIA link between the two trophies is read from those descriptions.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Late-story missions can be long, so stock up on health and armour beforehand and keep a save at the mission start in case you want to replay a choice.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's own completion tracker. This gold trophy is the natural last stop before the platinum: story, strangers, collectibles and activities all feed the percentage. If you stall in the high nineties, audit in this order — stranger strands, collectible counters, then activity golds — because those are the categories players most often leave one item short.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Official description and gold grade: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. The audit order is this app's own advice from the official trophy descriptions.
steps: Finish the story and all 8 stranger strands (Stages 1–2).
Clear collectibles: 18 meditation spots, 100 WAiNK locations, 3 card sets, 52 areas explored.
Clear activities: 42 Shooting Range golds, 14 Top Fun wins, 20 race wins, 250 stunts.
Check the in-game completion screen category by category against this tracker.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in total. Stunts accumulate during normal play — jumps, near misses and stunt driving all feed the same counter PlayStation tracks — so check your count here before grinding. If you are short at the end, pick a fast car and a repeatable jump route and run it in short sessions; the counter in this tracker mirrors PSN's target of 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Official description and the 250 target: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists (PSNProfiles shows the tracked count). Grinding advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. You do not need to win or master any of them — starting each activity is enough. The fastest route is to sweep the activity markers region by region during the collectibles stage, so you are never travelling just for this trophy.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Official description and the 9 activity types: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Routing advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the hardest pure-skill trophy on the list, so treat it like practice, not a race: learn one challenge's target pattern at a time, use the counter here to mark golds off, and take breaks — tired aim is the main reason runs fail. Challenges are repeatable, so nothing here can be permanently missed.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Official description and the 42-challenge count: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists (PSN tracks the count). Practice advice is this app's own.
steps: Unlock the Shooting Range and clear each challenge once to learn its layout.
Re-run challenges one by one for gold; tick each gold in the counter.
If a challenge stalls, change weapon class and come back fresh.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. You need one win per location, not a perfect record, so a lost race costs only a retry. Work through the locations as you explore each region and tick them off in the counter — 14 wins total.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Official description and the 14 locations: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word that matters is 'different': farming one easy track 20 times will not count. Rotate through race markers across Leonida, keep a note of which ones you have won, and use the counter here to reach 20 distinct wins.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. The distinct-race reading follows the official wording.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activity types, so this pairs naturally with Master of None: learn the fishing minigame on ordinary catches first, then take on Cal when the timing feels comfortable. If you lose, the challenge can be retried.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. 'Complete' means finishing the game, not just starting it, so pick the shortest arcade cabinet you find and play it through once. This also counts toward trying every activity type.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands run in several parts: find Andy, play each part as it unlocks, and the trophy pops at the strand's last mission. Do it during Stage 2, alongside the other stranger finales, rather than leaving strands for the very end.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger strands can stop appearing as the story advances. Finish Andy's strand when it opens and keep a save before the final story mission, so a closed strand never forces a new game.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Strand timing advice is this app's own, from the official Strangers & Freaks description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Work through Kenton's earlier parts as they appear, then finish the strand's closing mission. It also counts toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.missableNote: Like the other stranger finales, Kenton's strand may close if the story moves past it. Clear it in Stage 2 and keep a rotating save.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Play Billy's parts in order as they unlock across Leonida, and the trophy unlocks when the strand ends. Pair it with the other stranger finales in Stage 2 so no strand is forgotten.
trophies.missableNote: Billy's strand is a stranger strand and can be left behind by story progress. Finish it while it is active; a pre-finale save is your safety net.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each strand is a short chain of missions for one character — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a named finale trophy, and Bret's hunt sits in the same family. Count a strand only when its final mission is done, and use the counter here to track all 8.
trophies.missableNote: The 8 strands are spread across the whole state and individual strands can close as the story advances. Start strands when you meet them and finish all 8 before the final mission if you can.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Official description and the 8-strand count: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.
steps: Meet strangers as you explore; start every strand you find.
Finish each strand's chain, including the named finales for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Tick strands off in the counter until you reach 8.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Play through Randy's earlier missions as they unlock, then finish the strand. Counts toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.missableNote: Randy's finale belongs to a stranger strand that may close late in the story. Clear it in Stage 2 with the other stranger finales.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Work through Tyrone's chain of missions as they appear and finish the closing one. Like the other named finales, it also feeds the 8-strand Strangers & Freaks count.
trophies.missableNote: Tyrone's strand can be left behind by story progress like the other stranger strands. Finish it while active and keep a pre-finale save.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots sit at quiet, scenic places — viewpoints, beaches and high ground — so sweep them region by region during Stage 3 and tick each one in the counter. Meditation spots are collectibles, not missables: they stay available, so a missed spot is a trip back, not a lost trophy.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Official description and the 18 spots: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Sweep advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Accept Bret's request when it appears, track the marked animal, and complete the hunt as instructed. Because it hangs off a character strand, treat it as missable and clear it in Stage 2 with the other stranger work.
trophies.missableNote: Bret's hunt is tied to a stranger-style strand. Take it on when Bret offers it rather than saving it for post-story cleanup, in case the strand closes.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards come from packs and pickups around Leonida; a set is complete only when every card in it is collected, so track sets, not loose cards, in the counter here. Silver grade reflects the grind: buy packs whenever you pass a shop selling them, and finish the last cards of a set before starting a new one.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Official description, silver grade and the 3-set target: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 different locations. This is a pure collectibles sweep: work town by town and landmark by landmark, ticking the counter as you go, and pair it with the meditation spots and card hunting so one trip clears several counters. At 100 locations it is one of the longer silver grinds, but nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Official description, silver grade and the 100-location count: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Routing advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's bite-size objectives scattered through activities and free roam; most players finish many without trying. Check your count here late in Stage 4 and deliberately chase the shortest remaining challenges to reach 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Official description and the 50-challenge count: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, build up to a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely — the stars must fully clear while your partner is with you. Plan the escape before you start: a fast car, a route out of the search area, and a quiet place to wait out the heat. Do it in Stage 2 while your partner is guaranteed to be around.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner with you. Partner availability can change with the story, so earn this while your partner is still travelling with you — do not leave it for post-story cleanup.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Escape planning is this app's own advice from the official wording.
steps: Make sure your partner is with you in free roam.
Raise the wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level fully clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level alive the whole time. Pick 3 shops close together, rob the first, move straight to the second and third without hiding long enough for the stars to clear, then escape once all 3 are done. The trophy checks the streak, not the money.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner present and one continuous wanted level across all 3 robberies. If the wanted level clears mid-run, start again; if your partner stops travelling with you, this can become unavailable — do it in Stage 2.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Route advice is this app's own.
steps: Bring your partner and pick 3 nearby shops.
Rob shop one, then two, then three — never let the wanted level fully clear.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Discovery builds up naturally as you drive, steal and buy your way around Leonida, so check the counter before grinding: most players are closer than they think. For the last few, visit vehicle showrooms, marinas and airfields, where rarer models cluster.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Official description and the 100-vehicle count: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up rather than hoping for it: find a group of at least 5 enemies close together, make sure Combat Focus is fully charged, then activate it once and drop all 5 before it ends. If you only get 4, the attempt does not count — recharge and try again.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Setup advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, get into the airport area and leave in a way the airport did not plan for, such as taking an aircraft out without clearance. Finishing the VCIA Takedown story mission first teaches you the layout. Expect a wanted level; plan the exit before you go in.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. The plain-language reading is this app's own interpretation of the official wording; the game does not publish a step list.

trophies.guide: The official description is a joke, not an instruction: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' points at the Rhino tank. The natural reading is to get inside a Rhino and use it — steal one when the military response brings one out, or find one parked, then drive it. Because PlayStation publishes no step list, treat this as 'operate a Rhino tank' and try it during a high wanted level when Rhinos appear.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. The Rhino reading is this app's own interpretation, flagged as such — no source publishes exact steps.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all — no alarms raised by witnesses, no wanted level from being seen. Scout the store first, note cameras and staff sightlines, and go in when the floor is quiet. If you are spotted, the attempt is void: leave, let things cool down, and try again clean.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Stealth advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. A robbery only counts once you have escaped, so treat every vault as two jobs: get in and out of the vault, then lose the wanted level. Five successful vault escapes earn this silver; tick each escape in the counter. Vault money also funds the spending and property trophies in Stage 5.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Official description, silver grade and the 5-vault count: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the money, and then lose the wanted level — the escape is part of the trophy, not an afterthought. Armored trucks appear on city routes during the day; block the road ahead of one rather than chasing it.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Exploration fills in as you travel, so this trophy usually completes itself during the collectibles sweep — check the counter after Stage 3 and drive or fly through any area still fogged on your map. The 52-area count is what PlayStation tracks.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Official description and the 52-area count: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists (PSN tracks the count). Advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. You need coverage, not volume: one successful robbery per gang, nine in total. Keep a gang checklist — the counter here counts gangs cleared — and expect each operation to be defended, so arrive armed and with an escape vehicle ready.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Official description and the 9 gangs: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a beachfront bar or viewpoint spot that serves cocktails, and use the drink interaction while looking out over the water. It is a small moment trophy: the location and the view are the requirement, so do it at the beach, not at an inland bar.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. The beachfront reading follows the official wording.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: get into a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass, the way the description pictures it. Pick a showroom with a display car near the windows, start the car, and exit through the front. Expect a wanted level and plan the drive away.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. The through-the-glass reading is this app's own interpretation of 'classic style'.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — 'follow-through' is the bowling term the description plays on. Find the alley, start a game and bowl; the trophy is about playing there, not about your score. Bowling also counts as an activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. The bowling reading follows the official wording.

trophies.guide: The official description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is deliberately vague, so this app will not invent exact steps. The safe reading is that it rewards doing something notable together with your partner in front of people: earn it while your partner is travelling with you, during Stage 2, and try partner activities in busy public places. If it has not popped by the finale, your pre-finale save is the way back.
trophies.missableNote: The description ties this to your partnership. Anything partner-based is safest earned while your partner is still with you — clear it in Stage 2 alongside Hot Together and Retail Therapy.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. No public source publishes exact steps; the partner-activity reading is this app's own, flagged as interpretation.

trophies.guide: Make choices — for better or worse. PlayStation tracks this trophy with a counter that runs to 500, which means it rewards the accumulated weight of decisions across the game rather than one single moment. The practical approach: always engage with choice prompts instead of skipping them, play stranger strands fully, and watch the counter here as you go.
trophies.missableNote: Choices happen during story and stranger missions. If you rush past optional choices, the counter may fall short — engage with choices as they appear and keep a rotating save so a missed branch can be replayed.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Official description and the tracked count to 500: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists (PSNProfiles shows the progress target). Advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: succeed at something on your second attempt after failing the first. The description gives no named activity, so the honest guide is this — when you fail an activity, race or challenge, retry it immediately and succeed on the retry. Players earn this naturally while chasing Shooting Range golds and race wins, so do not grind it separately until the end.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. The retry reading is this app's own interpretation of the official wording.

trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' — this trophy rewards witnessing something strange. The official list names no place or event, so this app will not invent one. Explore Leonida's odd corners during the collectibles sweep, investigate anything that looks like an easter egg or an unexplained scene, and let it happen naturally; hidden trophies like this are designed to be stumbled into.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. No source publishes a location; this guide says so rather than inventing one.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike a person with a melee weapon as you pass, knocking them down like a bowling pin. Use a slow pass on a quiet street so the swing connects, and expect a wanted level afterwards. Despite the name, this has nothing to do with the bowling alley trophy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations in Stage 5 all feed this — and your contacts convert them into clean money. Launder in batches as you rob, and track the running total in the counter until it reaches $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: Official description and the $250,000 figure: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. The robbery link follows the official robbery trophy descriptions.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops combined. Every purchase counts toward one shared total, so normal play — clothes, weapons, car parts, card packs — builds it steadily. Save before any single huge purchase in case you want the money back, and check the counter before deliberate splurging.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Official description and the $100,000 figure: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are the property purchases on the list, so buy each one as your Stage 5 money allows and tick them off in the counter. Property purchases also help the $100,000 spending trophy, so sequence them together: rob, launder, buy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Official description and the 8 properties: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Sequencing advice is this app's own.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the in-game Scooter Bros app on your phone and register vehicles you own or control until 10 are on the app. It pairs well with Whip It Good: while discovering your 100 vehicles, register 10 of them here and both counters move together.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Official description and the 10-vehicle count: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists. Advice is this app's own.
